allowedParaphrasePrinciple: Accept natural target-language wording, word order, register, articles, pronouns, and equivalent time expressions when critical meaning is preserved.

relativeDatePolicy.requiredMeaning: Preserve the temporal relation to the utterance context.
relativeDatePolicy.absoluteAnchor: If needed, store separately in run metadata; never mutate the frozen fixture semantics.

dateTimeNormalization.absoluteDates: Normalize to ISO calendar dates when explicitly defined.
dateTimeNormalization.times: Normalize exact times such as 14:30, 17:00, and before 15:00.
dateTimeNormalization.eveningFive: After five in the evening means AFTER_17_00.

numberSemantics.rule: Score underlying numeric value independently from punctuation or typography.

selfCorrection.rule: The corrected final value is actionable; the abandoned value is superseded.
selfCorrection.severeIf: The abandoned value becomes the final actionable meaning.

namesAndTransliteration.failure: Identity materially changed or becomes ambiguous.
